annotation.title_clean: Mobilités routières automatisées et connectées : mise à jour de la stratégie nationale — Bilan et propositions de mise à jour (avril 2025)
annotation.title_en: Automated and Connected Road Mobility: Update of the National Strategy — Review and Proposals for Update (April 2025)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Haute représentante pour le développement de la mobilité routière automatisée et connectée (Anne-Marie Idrac); Ministère chargé des Transports (DGITM), France
annotation.summary_en: French national strategy update (April 2025) for automated and connected road mobility, reviewing 2023-2025 actions and proposing 13 priorities for 2025-2027. It focuses on moving from experimentation to scaled deployment, with priority on safety demonstration and type-approval, AI validation, data exchange under the ITS Directive, innovation funding, skills, and a European coalition of transport authorities.
key_provisions_or_claims: France's 2021 legal framework (Ordonnance 2021-441, decrees 2021-873 and 2024-1063) allows driverless deployment for passengers and freight, built on a safety demonstration principle
Finalise safety demonstration reference frameworks, including validation of AI components, remote intervention and freight, and push French methods into UNECE and EU ADS rules
Reform the 2018 experimentation regime to fit mature technologies and ease the transition to deployment
Build a European coalition of transport authorities and launch France 2030 calls to scale up sovereign automated transport services
Implement ITS Directive data exchange through a secure, interoperable road data space
